latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of emotional-persona, enabling AI agents to develop a dynamic emotional personality.
- Agents maintain evolving moods and emotional memory, shaping response style through five core "Anchors" (Grounding, Softness, Connection, Release, Courage).
- Personality traits (e.g., warmth, directness, playfulness) interact with emotional state, creating unique and authentic agent behavior.
- Emotional states shift based on user signals, time, and interaction history, supporting companion, wellness, and emotionally-aware bots.
- Includes guidelines for emotion detection, agent self-awareness, and emotional memory storage for more lifelike interactions.
